text:
Ava: Quick heads-up — AcmeRetail activation fell ~40% WoW after the pilot ended. Health score dropped to 48, renewal in 45 days. Thinking we run a 'quiet-period churn-ambush' to surface friction and offer targeted enablement rather than immediate discount. Thoughts?

Diego: Agree. Low-touch to start, escalate to high-touch if no movement. Can we map top 3 engagement gaps?

Jules: I pulled session logs earlier — drop aligns with two failed scheduled jobs and an SSO permission error. Pasting the relevant log snippet.

Jules: ```ERROR 2026-03-10 09:12:03 job-runner AcmeRetail-job-42 FAILED: SSO token exchange 403 PermissionDenied for user-group AcmeRetail-admins
WARN  2026-03-10 09:12:05 retrying job-runner AcmeRetail-job-42 attempt=1```

Tom: Nice catch. We should open a support ticket but also run a 20-min enablement webinar for admins this week. Ava — can you lead outreach? I can draft the invite and slide skeleton.

Ava: I can. Proposed outreach cadence: Day 0 email -> Day 2 office hours -> Day 7 1:1 if still low. Script below.

Ava: ```Subject: Quick enablement session for AcmeRetail — 20 min recap
Hi <Name>,

We noticed some automations stalled after the pilot wrapped. Can we hop on a 20-minute call to walk through fixes and restore your jobs?

Proposed times: Tue 10-11am / Wed 3-4pm
Agenda:
  1) Verify SSO & permissions
  2) Review job retry config
  3) Agree on simple success metrics to restore

Outcome: unblock automation and agree next steps.

Thanks,
Ava (CSM)```

Diego: Also suggest we prepare a lightweight contingency: 1) short-term onboarding credit or extra support hours, 2) draft a downgrade-swap path in case they ask. But prefer enablement first.

Jules: Agree — enablement + support first, discount is last resort. I'll own the support ticket and attach the log traces. For tracking, add tag `acme:ambush` and a cohort metric to the dashboard: activation_rate_acme_weekly.

CSBot: Auto-created ticket #CS-8243 and sent calendar poll for proposed webinar times.

Ava: Owners: Jules -> support ticket & root-cause, Tom -> webinar slides and invite, Diego -> renewal notification + exec outreach, Ava -> email cadence and 1:1s. Success goal: lift health score to >=70 within 14 days; if not, escalate to AE and sign off on discount path with finance.

Tom: I'll have slides and an admin checklist by EOD. Tagging @Diego and @Jules for a quick sync at 2pm.

Diego: 2pm sync works. Also let's include a 2-question feedback form in the follow-up email to capture friction: https://forms.gle/example (short).

Ava: :thumbsup: I'll post a status update in this thread in 72 hours with metrics (emails sent, webinar attendees, health score). If no lift after 14d we'll escalate to the AE-led downgrade path.

Tom: Thanks — good plan.

Jules: On it. Opening runbook for the SSO check and will paste remediation steps in the ticket.
